feeds.title: The Millennial Runaway
feeds.description: Welcome to the Millennial Runaway. I'm a part-time traveller sticking the middle finger up to societal pressures and travelling by whatever means necessary. I hope that in recounting my experiences I will encourage others in my position to travel, and not be overcome with social pressures and media trends.

feeds.title: Pommie Travels Blog
feeds.description: Pommie Travels is award-winning travel blog established in 2009, featuring inspiration and tips for anyone wishing to travel the world. I'm here to give you all the best tips I have learned from all these years of travel, and to help you save money while you're at it!

feeds.title: Elite Daily
feeds.description: Elite Daily is the premier online news platform for and by millennials, the leading source for breaking news and entertainment for the future leaders of our generation. Our tagline, 'The Voice of Generation-Y,' not only reflects our commitment to delivering content specifically targeted for Generation-Y, but also content shaped by talented media professionals of the same demographic.
